phrase.text: The engine checks everything it can before running; whatever depends on concrete values, such as dividing by zero, it checks when running.

runs.text: The engine checks everything it can before running; whatever depends on concrete values, such as dividing by zero, it checks when running.
There are two moments to discover a problem:

entries.text: (static checking): the shape of the program, that names exist and that types fit. If something fails here, the program does not run.
(dynamic checking): whatever depends on the real value at that moment, such as dividing by zero, going outside an array or reading a variable without a value.

blocks.description: Two columns. Before running, shape, names, types and called subroutines are checked. When running, division by zero, indices, variables without a value and overflow are checked.

caption.text: What is checked at each moment. The earlier an error is found, the cheaper it is to fix.
